messages.subject: Project Forge — instruction: economics support (CMA merger review)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Martin,

We act for Pennington Industries on a CMA Phase 1 review of its completed acquisition of Halworth Pump Systems. We'd like to instruct Calderon to (1) pressure-test the share-of-supply estimates on the candidate frames, and (2) build a bidding/diversion analysis for UK municipal-water centrifugal and submersible pump tenders, 2022–2025, to support our no-SLC case.

Can you send a short scope and fee estimate? We're working to a tight timetable — briefing paper to the CMA early December.

Best regards
James

James Osei
Senior Associate | Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0531
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.subject: RE: Project Forge — instruction: economics support (CMA merger review)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear James,

Delighted to assist. Priya Nair (copied) will lead day to day. Scope as you set out; we'll also size the residual concern in case a remedy discussion arises. Estimate £72k–£88k plus VAT. We'll need the parties' tender records and management accounts — a data request follows from Priya today. We can turn the first cut of the bidding analysis around within ten working days of receiving clean data.

Kind regards
Martin

Dr Martin Calderon | Calderon Economics LLP
